headline: Brent Crude Falls to $100 as Traders Price Potential US-Iran Deal
summary: Brent crude fell $3.04 to $100.60 per barrel and WTI dropped $2.86 to $93.23 amid trader bets on a US-Iran settlement, marking a third consecutive decline in volatile trading.
why: Crude oil is a vital global commodity benchmark influencing energy sector equities, transportation costs, and macroeconomic inflation metrics.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Brent crude spot and futures prices dropped as traders priced in a potential settlement.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Crude benchmarks declined as oil traders discounted regional threats and priced in expectations of a U.S.-Iran settlement.
